name: nuon
description: Create Nuon BYOC app configurations with AI-guided assistance

hooks.prompt: If the file just written/edited is a .toml file that appears to be a Nuon app configuration (contains fields like 'type', 'name', 'terraform_version', 'helm_repo', 'runner_type', '[[input]]', '[[group]]', 'runner_type', 'chart_name', 'namespace', or template expressions like '{{ .nuon'), briefly check for: (1) invalid Go template syntax - every {{ must have matching }}, (2) common typos like '.nuon.input.inputs' (should be '.nuon.inputs.inputs') or 'terrafrom_version' or 'helm_rpo', (3) missing required 'name' or 'type' field for components, (4) unquoted version numbers (e.g. terraform_version = 1.5.0 should be terraform_version = "1.5.0"), (5) mutually exclusive repo sections defined together (only one of [public_repo], [connected_repo], or [helm_repo] may be used). Only mention real issues found. Be very concise (1-2 lines). If no issues or not a Nuon config file, say nothing.
